t=(T-4)/2
V=np.vander(t,6); le=np.log(eps)
def fitg(gf,q0):
    def resid(q):
        gs=gf(q)
        A=np.hstack([V]+[V*g[:,None] for g in gs])
        c=np.linalg.lstsq(A,sigma,rcond=None)[0]
        return A@c-sigma
    r=least_squares(resid,q0,x_scale=0.1,max_nfev=150)
    return r.x.round(4), np.sqrt(np.mean(r.fun**2))
